ruleDefinitions.name: Credential Dumping Attempt Via Svchost
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects when a process tries to access the memory of svchost to potentially dump credentials. Note: Unmapped fields: TargetImage, GrantedAccess, SourceImage

sequences.query: (TargetImage = RGX("\\\\svchost\\\.exe$") AND GrantedAccess = "0x143a") AND  NOT ((SourceImage = RGX("\\\\services\\\.exe$") OR SourceImage = RGX("\\\\msiexec\\\.exe$")))
